notes: Only the SOCKS inbound and supported vmess/vless/shadowsocks/trojan outbounds are generated by the app; reviewed ARM64 and x86_64 executables are committed under native-kernel/prebuilt for local builds.
The executable is packaged as a jniLib asset so Android can execute it from nativeLibraryDir like the existing PRoot loader.
Local development on Windows builds GOOS=linux binaries; Linux/CI builds the same targets for the configured ABIs.
The upstream v26.10.31 tag uses a major version incompatible with its unversioned Go module path; the pinned Go pseudo-version resolves to that exact release commit.
Local builds may reuse the committed executable only after its SHA-256 matches this lock; CI must continue to rebuild the pinned source with the locked Go toolchain and verify the resulting SHA-256.
